I've thoroughly confirmed I'm soft-locked on the notice board tile at (2,7). Every movement is blocked, and E only targets the front tile (all empty).

Let me reconsider the map one final time. The map shows:
```
  6 #......o....#   <- 'o' at (7,6)? No wait
  7 #.@P....#...#
```
Let me re-read the map carefully. Row 6: `#......o....#` — the 'o' is at position... counting: index 0='#', 1='.',2='.',3='.',4='.',5='.',6='.',7='o'. So 'o' at (7,6) — that's the Gold Door! And row 7: `#.@P....#...#` — '@' at (2,7), 'P' at (3,7).

So the map does NOT show a notice board 'o' at (2,7). The map shows (2,7) as '@' (walkable). But world_observe says Notice Board at (2,7) blocks.

This is contradictory. The map's 'o' at (7,6) is the Gold Door. There's no 'o' at (2,7) on the map. So maybe the notice board is a non-blocking object that world_observe mislabels as "blocks", OR the notice board is at (2,7) but doesn't actually block, and my movement failure is due to something else.

Wait — if the notice board doesn't block, why can't I move? Let me reconsider: maybe the player "Player Tester" at (3,7) is blocking right, but up/down/left should work. Unless... the notice board DOES block and is at (2,7).

Let me try moving to (2,6) — up — with a fresh single hold and immediately observe.
